description: Zero-overhead, terminal-native local-LLM orchestrator. Run any engine, any model via the same proxy.
post_install: Write-Host 'llamastash installed. Run `llamastash init` to set up models and llama-server.'
notes: First run: `llamastash init` walks through model + GPU detection.
Then `llamastash` to launch the TUI, or `llamastash --help` for the CLI.
AMD GPU detection on Windows is on the roadmap; CPU and Vulkan (discrete GPU) routing works today.
